cursor.rationale: The first-party harness reference explicitly says two coding CLIs are supported today: Claude Code and Codex. Other commands are plain shell sessions without harness integration; provider gateways and MCP clients do not add a coding harness.

byo-subscription.rationale: Existing agent authentication is reused; gateway profiles add own-key/local-model routes.

parallel-runs.rationale: Concurrent sessions can run on one or several issues.

issue-tracking.rationale: Native board issues persist independently of sessions.

pr-workflow.rationale: Git UI commits/publishes branches; session gh creates PRs.

review-ui.rationale: Built-in inline diff and commit history support review.

self-hosting.rationale: Local desktop issues/settings use user-machine SQLite; hosted parity is not established.

free-tier.rationale: Free-forever one-user plan includes Desktop and unlimited local sessions.

local.rationale: Desktop sessions execute locally; remote board sync is not proof of remote agent compute.

own-server.rationale: The documented complete Desktop execution architecture is local PTY processes on the desktop host. Remote workspace sync is board metadata, not remote coding-agent execution; separate Lanes Compute is outside this product scope.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The documented complete Desktop execution architecture is local PTY processes on the desktop host. Remote workspace sync is board metadata, not remote coding-agent execution; separate Lanes Compute is outside this product scope.

worktree.rationale: Each issue can get a branch/worktree; sibling sessions share it.

license.rationale: Desktop README specifies proprietary licensing; separate Lanes Link is not the desktop license.

starting-price.rationale: Free-forever one-user plan includes Desktop and unlimited local sessions.

subscription.rationale: Pro $19/month for up to ten members.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete Desktop plan schedule is free solo and a flat $19/month workspace for up to ten members, plus custom Enterprise. It has no no-paid-plan Desktop pricing option. Separate future Compute billing is not Desktop pricing.

per-seat.rationale: The complete Desktop plan schedule is free solo and a flat $19/month workspace for up to ten members, plus custom Enterprise. It has no per-seat Desktop pricing option. Separate future Compute billing is not Desktop pricing.

usage-based.rationale: The complete Desktop plan schedule is free solo and a flat $19/month workspace for up to ten members, plus custom Enterprise. It has no usage-based Desktop pricing option. Separate future Compute billing is not Desktop pricing.

compute.rationale: The complete Desktop plan schedule is free solo and a flat $19/month workspace for up to ten members, plus custom Enterprise. It has no compute Desktop pricing option. Separate future Compute billing is not Desktop pricing.

one-time.rationale: The complete Desktop plan schedule is free solo and a flat $19/month workspace for up to ten members, plus custom Enterprise. It has no one-time Desktop pricing option. Separate future Compute billing is not Desktop pricing.

coordinator.rationale: The Lanes Desktop MCP server, a research preview users can enable in Settings, lets a connected agent start sessions, check their status and read their history. Product-supplied coordinator tools driven by a third-party agent meet the written coordinator rule. Scope: Lanes Desktop.

web-client.rationale: The complete primary Lanes Desktop client inventory is a native Mac app. Other Lanes family products or the account dashboard do not establish an agent workspace client for this option.

mobile-web.rationale: The complete primary Lanes Desktop client inventory is a native Mac app. Other Lanes family products or the account dashboard do not establish an agent workspace client for this option.

unattended-triggers.rationale: The official loop guide documents a connected harness schedule/loop polling and starting Lanes sessions over its built-in MCP. Scheduling runs in that harness and requires Desktop to remain running.

laptop-independent.rationale: The local PTY runtime requires the Desktop host to remain running; remote board sync does not keep its coding processes running during laptop sleep.
